snippet.title: Super Solitaire - PlayStation 5 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Experience the classic card game with new beautiful animations and solve the puzzles by moving the cards into the right piles.
Anyone who knows the game from their computer will love this app and even if you have never played Solitaire before, the game is very easy to learn.

Published by Ocean Media
Developed by The Binary Family
Also released for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S
